basis.quote:
it is ordered that the Execu-
tive Mansion and the several Executive Departments at Washington
be draped in mourning and the flags thereon placed at half- staff for a
period of thirty days , and that on the day of the funeral all public busi-
ness in the Departments be suspended
basis.role: operative terms with own duration: thirty days

proposed_intervals.scope: whole order (mourning for Rutherford B. Hayes)
proposed_intervals.end_basis: order's own terms: half-staff 'for a period of thirty days' from 1893-01-18 (inclusive count; exclusive reading ends 1893-02-17); funeral-day suspension was one day

searches_run: cruden.py number EO:29 (own run, /tmp/claude-0/herschel-H6-work/H6-w03/cruden-EO_29.json): 7 hits (hits are War Food/ICC/OPA orders and EO 30, none acting on EO 29)
material_gaps: Richardson 1898 is a printed compilation, not the signed original; page images not inspected; funeral date not held (immaterial given 30-day limit)
rationale: EO 29 (Benjamin Harrison, 18 Jan 1893) orders mourning formalities on Hayes's death: draping and half-staff for thirty days and one day of suspended business at the funeral. Its own terms limit it to thirty days, so it ended by about 1893-02-17 and was not in effect on 2026-10-14. Subject and date agree with the register.
